set.body:
Make the diagram the complete semantic input to generalized PCA without turning it into a monolithic record.

Acceptance:
- Add a normalized RowMeasure distinct from row geometry.
- Add NoCentering, CenterByMeasure, CenterOrthogonally, and AlreadyCenteredBy with evidence.
- Represent centering as the projection I - 1 mu* and test idempotence, annihilation of one, and annihilation by mu.
- Keep column transformations distinct from column forms while recording induced forms when explicitly requested.
- Compose diagram core, preparation, data semantics, and audit or provenance subobjects into one immutable consumer-facing value.
- Represent complete data explicitly and reserve distinct states for missing cells rather than treating missingness, missing views, and unmatched entities alike.
- Require RejectSingularGeometry, RestrictToSupport, RegularizeWith, or WorkInQuotientSpace for PSD geometry.
- Support restriction returns an effective nominal space, embedding, reduced SPD form, discarded nullity, and threshold.
- Rebuild the semantic GenPCA result on the diagram and expose the prepared diagram and numerical certificates used.
- Keep arithmetic centering and current null-range behavior only through explicit compatibility policies.
- Transformations return new diagrams and state which certificates remain valid.

Verification: shared JVM and JS law tests plus existing R-backed fixtures.
set.title: multivar constitution: measures, centering, singular geometry, and diagram v2
